title: Continuity-Free Near-Minimax Leading-Order Regret for CVaR-UCBVI
abstract: arXiv:2608.28960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For finite-horizon tabular CVaR reinforcement learning, prior work proves a $\widetilde{O}(\tau^{-1}\sqrt{SAK})$ leading regret bound for arbitrary normalized return laws and the sharper $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/\tau})$ rate under a density lower bound. We show that the same Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI algorithm attains the sharper rate without continuity assumptions. The key is a selected-budget self-bound: the conditional variance of the episode shortfall is at most $\tau$ plus the value-estimation width. Substitution into the original Bernstein decomposition yields, with high probability, $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{SAK/\tau}+(SAHK^{1/4}+S^2AH)/\tau)$ regret for arbitrary normalized return laws, including atomic, mixed, and continuous laws. The $\tau^{-1/2}$ leading term matches the expected-regret minimax lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Thus Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI is minimax-optimal over the full return-law class in the leading-order regime;

translated_title: CVaR-UCBVI的无连续性假设近极小极大领先阶后悔界
translated_abstract: 对于有限时域表格型CVaR强化学习，先前的工作针对任意归一化回报分布证明了 Õ(τ⁻¹√(SAK)) 的领先后悔界，并在密度下界假设下证明了更优的 Õ(√(SAK/τ)) 速率。我们证明同一个Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI算法在无需连续性假设的情况下即可达到更优的速率。其关键是一个选定预算自界：回合短缺的条件方差至多为τ加上价值估计宽度。将其代入原始Bernstein分解后，以高概率得到针对任意归一化回报分布（包括原子分布、混合分布和连续分布）的 Õ(√(SAK/τ)+(SAHK^{1/4}+S²AH)/τ) 后悔界。其中 τ^{-1/2} 领先项在对数因子范围内匹配期望后悔的极小极大下界。因此，Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI在领先阶范围内对全部回报分布类别都是极小极大最优的。
tldr: 本文证明Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI算法通过一个选定预算自界技术（回合短缺条件方差至多为τ加价值估计宽度），在无需任何连续性假设下即可对任意回报分布达到与极小极大下界匹配的领先阶后悔界。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the Bernstein CVaR-UCBVI algorithm achieves minimax-optimal leading-order regret for arbitrary return laws without continuity assumptions, via a selected-budget self-bound showing the conditional variance of episode shortfall is at most τ plus the value-estimation width.
